news.title: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon says markets are in 'greed' mode as AI companies seek billions
news.detail: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon's comments come as investors prepare for what will be one of the busiest periods for equity issuance in years.

news.title: 消息人士：SpaceX冲刺史上最大IPO，含绿鞋期权目标估值1.75万亿美元
news.detail: 两名知情人士周二向路透社透露，埃隆・马斯克旗下航天与卫星企业 SpaceX 计划通过史上规模空前的首次公开募股募资至少 750 亿美元。

news.title: SpaceX要求压低IPO承销费率 但华尔街投行仍有望分食5亿美元收入
news.detail: 马斯克旗下SpaceX正在与经手其IPO的华尔街投行谈判，希望支付极低的费率。不过，即便收费标准大幅压低，负责此次上市的银行仍有望从这场创纪录的IPO中获得约5亿美元收入。

news.title: The last time the S&P 500 rose this rapidly — outside of recession periods — was before the 1987 crash
news.detail: There are some big dislocations in the stock market that are worrying investors.

news.title: Microsoft unveils new AI models to lessen reliance on OpenAI and lower costs for developers
news.detail: At its Build developer conference, Microsoft is announcing series of generative AI models to try and crack a market controlled by OpenAI, Anthropic and Google.

news.title: Alphabet just stepped up the AI spending race. Why that could be an overhang for the hyperscaler stocks
news.detail: The Google parent's equity issuance announced Monday follows sagging free cash flows amid the infrastructure boom.

news.title: 特朗普签署AI行政令以加强政府监管
news.detail: 美国总统特朗普周二签署了一项行政命令，要求人工智能公司在公开发布功能强大的模型前30天，须向政府提供相关模型。而就在两周前，他刚刚搁置了该命令的一个先前版本。

news.title: 慧与股价创纪录大涨 AI需求推动公司上调销售展望
news.detail: 慧与周二股价飙升，涨幅创史上最大，此前该公司全年销售展望超出华尔街预期，公司称在人工智能（AI）带动下，其服务器和网络业务需求大幅增长。

news.title: Why BlackRock's Rick Rieder feels 'a bit more relaxed' about AI bull market than dotcom era
news.detail: 'I think you gotta stay in,' says the top BlackRock investing official, as earnings growth and cash to be reinvested in stocks support the AI bull market.
